resources.string: This item is no longer available.
This title can\'t be used. Titles need visible text, no spaces at the start or end, and at most 200 characters.
Notes can be at most 4,096 characters.
Only a Telegram user from your contacts can be chosen.
This changed while you were deciding. Nothing was sent — look at the current version and try again.
Only the task\'s owner can do this. Nothing was changed.
Your access to this task isn\'t active, so nothing was changed. Only the owner can invite you again.
%1$s won\'t be able to send you task invitations, and their pending invitations are hidden. Tasks you already accepted from them stay until you leave them.
You see only the title, the deadline and the sender\'s Telegram ID. You can\'t change anything.
You also see the notes, can mark the task done or not done, and can leave at any time. Only the owner edits, shares or deletes it. This access doesn\'t expire.
The owner\'s lists and assignees are never shared. A sender is named only when this Telegram account already knows them; the number is their Telegram ID.
Unblocking lets this sender invite you again. Invitations hidden while they were blocked do not come back.
Edit, mark done or not done, share and delete. Only you see the list and the assignee.
Only you have access to this task.

Sync confirmation pending; the recipient\'s access may not reflect this change yet. Until they accept, they see only the title, the deadline and your Telegram ID. A previous recipient may keep access until the change is applied.
Until they accept, only the title, the deadline and your Telegram ID. They can\'t change anything.

Sees the notes, can mark it done or not done, or leave. Can\'t edit, share or delete. Access doesn\'t expire: it ends when you stop sharing, share with someone else or delete the task, or when they leave.
Sync confirmation pending; the recipient\'s access may not reflect this change yet.
Mark it done or not done, or leave. You can\'t edit, share or delete it.
Your access isn\'t active, so you can\'t change this task. Only the owner can invite you again.
Edits, shares and deletes. Their lists and assignees aren\'t shared with you.
Your access doesn\'t expire. It ends if the owner stops sharing, shares the task with someone else or deletes it, or if you leave.
Only you see the assignee. It does not share the task, invite or notify anyone.

Sharing sends an invitation through the Zenlygram Tasks service, not a Telegram message. Until they accept, the recipient sees only the title, the deadline and your Telegram ID; after that, the task without your list or assignee. They see it the next time their app syncs.
A completed task can\'t be shared. Reopen it first.
It disappears from your Cloud tasks. The owner can see that you left. To get it back, the owner has to invite you again.

%1$s will get an invitation to “%2$s” in Zenlygram Tasks. Until they accept, they see the title, the deadline and your Telegram ID; after accepting, also the notes and whether it\'s done. Your list and assignee stay private. The Zenlygram server processes the invitation; it expires in 7 days if not answered. No Telegram message is sent.
This replaces the current invitation. The previous invitation or shared access ends when the server applies this change.
Save or discard your edits before sharing.
This task has changes that are not sent yet. Sharing becomes available once they are.
The recipient will no longer see this task.
The recipient loses access when the server applies this change. To share again, send a new invitation.
The server has a newer version. Keep it, or apply your change on top of it as a new change.
This task is no longer available
It was deleted or changed elsewhere. You can save your edits as a new task or discard them.
This task is no longer available to you. Your edits are kept until you save them as a new task or discard them.
Nothing here is merged or re-sent without your choice. Discarding removes the change from this device only.
Waiting — link your account to send
Waiting — the Tasks service is unavailable
Couldn\'t be sent after several tries
Your current plan doesn\'t allow creating this
The server didn\'t accept this change
Kept for review: the app found an inconsistency
Changed elsewhere since you edited it
Not sent: an earlier change it was based on was discarded
It no longer exists on the server
Not sent: this Telegram account is now linked to a different Zenlygram account
It was not sent and will be removed from this device.

This change was made while this Telegram account was linked to a different Zenlygram account, so it was not sent. Saving it as a new task creates it in the Zenlygram account linked now, under your current plan.
The server didn\'t accept this task as it is — the title, notes or assignee may not fit its rules. Change what needs fixing and save it as a new change. Nothing is sent before you save.
Nothing was changed. The same content would be refused again — edit it first, or discard the change.
This task has newer unsent changes. Discard them in Unsent Changes first, then fix this one.
The server didn\'t accept this list name. Change it to send the list again.
